problems.quote: δ ≥ (π_M – π_C)/(π_M – π_N), where π_M is monopoly profit, π_C is collusive profit, and π_N is Nash profit.
problems.problem: The grim-trigger condition for sustaining collusion is δ ≥ (π_D – π_C)/(π_D – π_N) where π_D is the one-shot deviation profit. Using monopoly profit π_M (which equals collusive profit π_C) makes the numerator zero and the formula incorrect.
problems.correction: δ ≥ (π_D – π_C)/(π_D – π_N), where π_D is deviation profit, π_C is collusive profit, and π_N is Nash profit.
problems.verifierReason: Original formula uses π_M (monopoly profit) instead of π_D (deviation profit); correction is standard grim-trigger condition.
